title: 边光
summary: 高光沿圆角边框绕行，不要铺满卡片。内层实心底，外层透明边框叠光束。品牌强调色，不要彩虹。
summaryEn: The highlight travels the rounded border — it does not flood the card. Solid inner fill, transparent border stacking the beam. Brand accent, not a rainbow.
asks: 高光该走边框还是铺满卡片？
asksEn: Should the highlight travel the border, or flood the card?

links.when: 高光走边框不是走字形
links.whenEn: a border beam is not a glyph-follow sweep
